ctx.x: You come down from Great Lakes. We had a good-sounding band, because we played there, we played in Chicago ten weeks. And then we were offered a tour with Louis Jordan. The tour took us into New York to play Apollo Polly Theater. And from Apollo Polly Theater into Washington, D.C.
Around the Horn. (Unintelligible) [Theater]-ed. Around the Horn, Howard, see.
(Unintelligible) And then we left there and we played -- we left Louis -- oh, that was the time we played Chicago. Were you with the band when we played Chicago, Charles?
